Finds the binding-set component (type 0x146ca5978) in control+0x30..+0x38 or creates it (0x48 bytes, vtable 0x145a71f80, attached with 0x14424b130 to 0x14417baa0(control); if control byte +0xa bit 0x10 it is marked live 0x101 and stale bindings are purged) and appends it to the component vector. Then allocates a 0x130-byte binding from pool *0x146ca5990: vtable 0x14588e320, Ne_ResourceHandle at +8, mode byte +0xf0, id_hash +0xf4, path string +0xf8, owner set +0x100, callback 0x1442b1210 at +0xd8, the two 16-byte delegates at +0x108 and +0x118, user_u32 at +0x128. An existing binding with the same id and delegates is destroyed first; the new one is appended to the set vector (+0x20..+0x30), bit 0x08 of +0xe8 = flag8, and it is resolved against the set's source (+0x38) via Vm_Binding_SetSourceAndResolve and Vm_Binding_ResolveAndSubscribe when the set is live. Returns id_hash. Callers 0x1437f30f0, 0x14380a1d0 and 0x144212290 are control class init functions: after Vm_Read_PropBinding succeeds they register the path with a per-property thunk pair and a u32 field of the control (e.g. id 0x34bfd32a with +0x70; 0xaebb323 with +0x94; 0x144212290 uses the djb2 hash of the path and +0xa8), always flag8=0, mode=0.
